mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies near Harriet Park with a temperature of 70 degrees, a third quarter moon, an overnight low of 60 degrees, and no rain expected.

The City of Verona has updated their engineering report archives for the Council and is encouraging residents to apply for the tri-shaw bike program for seniors or look into the rain barrel rebate policy to help with stormwater.
Today features live music at Paddy Mac's, the downtown farmer's market, and trivia night at the Bogey Factory, while tomorrow you can check out concerts in the park or trivia at Hop Haus.
On Thursday, July 31st, Verona police conducted a traffic stop that led to an arrest for O W I and citations for suspended registration.
Stop by for the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day today before they close at 10 PM. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Caramel Twist.
